page.overview:
Who is Dungeon Bro?

The can be found in a down a hole west of the in . The younger brother stands near the start of the path leading up to the , telling that he and his brother will be taking the treasure unless can use the to reach it first.

The older brother stands halfway up the path, wondering how he is not fast enough to reach the top. When reaches the , which contains a , they will both congratulate him, although while the older brother is impressed, the younger brother is skeptical and accuses of cheating.
